comment: GNSS/GPS policy for the S10+ (beyond2lte), Exynos 9820 platform. Read by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-gnss-diag.sh. The BCM4773 sensor-hub path is enumerated as well as generic GNSS nodes: device node -> driver binding -> firmware -> NMEA stream -> fix. The first failing stage is reported. A device node existing is not a fix and a fix cannot be observed indoors: outside-sky observation is the owner's, so the terminal verdict is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST and no coordinate is ever fabricated.

device.soc: Exynos 9820 (integrated GNSS path; vendor userspace required for assisted fix)

verdicts.READY_FOR_SKY: device node present, driver bound, NMEA sentences observed — an owner outdoors may wait for a fix (still NEEDS_OWNER_TEST)
verdicts.BLOCKED_KERNEL: no GNSS device node and no GNSS driver module bound
verdicts.BLOCKED_FIRMWARE: driver/node path exists but no GNSS firmware blob is present
verdicts.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_RESOURCE: kernel GNSS up but no userspace consumer (gpsd/gpspipe) installed
verdicts.NO_FIX: a stream is present but no position sentence has been decoded yet (indoors or cold start)
verdicts.PARTIAL: some stages present, some missing — read the per-stage lines

fix_test.comment: Owner procedure only. The repository scripts the monitor and the sentence counting; it never prints a coordinate it did not read, and it never claims a fix indoors.
steps: go outdoors with a clear view of the sky (or to a window with a wide view); a metal/glass-roofed space will not do
nuxel-gnss-diag.sh monitor 180      # bounded: prints sentence counts and any decoded fix
wait for $GNGGA/$GPGGA with a non-empty latitude/longitude and a fix quality of 1 (GPS) or 2 (DGPS)
cross-check the coordinate against the offline OSM map (nuxel-maps with A? tiles)
record the coordinate, accuracy, time-to-first-fix and sentence totals in this fragment
evidence_required_for_promotion: monitor prints decoded sentences of at least one NMEA type
a position sentence with a non-empty lat/lon and fix quality >= 1 is observed
the coordinate agrees with the offline map within the reported accuracy
time-to-first-fix is recorded (cold vs warm start stated)

offline_map.comment: Offline-first OSM integration: the Maps app must work with cached/offline tiles and must NOT require network for a cached area. The repository ships the tile layout policy and the attribution; it ships no fabricated map data.
